english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s body position or pose, including for a photograph.
For physical body position, this is the all-purpose choice.
Use this for the way someone holds or arranges their body, rather than their place or status.
Use this for the physical position or way someone carries their body, not their state of mind.

examples.english: When taking the photo, don't move; hold this pose.
examples.traditional: 影相嗰陣唔好郁，保持呢個姿勢。
